name: Krazy Kanguruh
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Crazy Kangaroo in Tirol

** **

Welcome to Tirol, where adventure meets charm! At Crazy Kangaroo, you’ll experience the wild side of the Alps like never before. Whether you're into high-flying bungee jumps, heart-pounding zip lines, or simply soaking in the breathtaking views of the Zillertal and Ötztal valleys, this is your playground.

** **

Thrills & Chills in the Heart of Tirol

** **

Located just outside Innsbruck, Crazy Kangaroo is the ultimate adrenaline hub. With over 20 different attractions, there’s something for every thrill-seeker—from the iconic Klettermax climbing wall to the Speed River, where you’ll race down a natural water slide at breakneck speeds. And don’t miss the Skywalk Tirol, a glass-bottomed bridge suspended 1,000 meters above the valley floor!

** **

More Than Just Adrenaline

** **

After working up an appetite, refuel with hearty Tiroler Gröstl or a classic Kaiserschmarrn at our cozy Hütte. Sip on a cold Tiroler Bier or a locally crafted Apfelstrudel while taking in the panoramic views. Whether you’re here for the adrenaline or the relaxation, Crazy Kangaroo delivers an unforgettable experience in the heart of Tirol.

** **

Plan Your Visit

** **

Open daily from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM (last entry at 5:00 PM). Tickets start at just €29.90 and include access to all attractions. Book online to secure your spot and avoid the queues. Pro Tip: Combine your visit with a trip to the nearby Nordkette for even more stunning Alpine scenery!

** **

Get Here

** **

Just a 15-minute drive from Innsbruck, Crazy Kangaroo is easily accessible by car or public transport. Take the Bus 4200 from Innsbruck’s Hauptbahnhof to the Hötting stop—we’ll be waiting!

** **

Ready for the Wild Side?

** **

Don’t just visit Tirol—conquer it! Whether you’re a seasoned adrenaline junkie or a first-timer, Crazy Kangaroo promises an experience you’ll talk about for years. Book your tickets today and get ready for the ride of your life!

**
